content:
Ana Santiago: Morning team — prepping a readout rehearsal this Thu 10:00 PT. Need final slide pack + run order by Wed EOD. Primary asks: confirm slide owners, demo fallback, and an exec one-pager. @Matt can you confirm demo fallback? :eyes:

Matt Chen: On it. Plan: static recording fallback + a short pre-recorded walkthrough. Will slot a canary demo in staging shard and run a smoke test. ETA Wed 3pm.

Sophia Patel: Slide pack link: https://drive.redwood/reports/1765-ebr-draft-v3.pptx — updated slide 6 (renewal signals) and slide 9 (risk heatmap). Please review.

Jon Reyes: I'll own slide 7 (onboarding progress). Will add churn mitigation bullets and the cohort retention chart. Need the customer-specific metrics from analytics — @Emily can you share the CSV?

Emily Tran: Uploading metrics now. Pulled DAU, activation time, support tickets (last 90d). CSV: /files/1765-customer-metrics.csv. Quick note: activation time improved ~18% after onboarding tweaks.

qbr-bot: Event created: "EBR Readout — Dry Run" Thu 10:00 PT. Invites sent to Ana, Matt, Sophia, Jon, Emily, execs.

Ana Santiago: For action tracking, add items to the runbook. Pasting the run order + action checklist here for visibility:

```
Run order:
1) Ana - Exec summary (5m)
2) Sophia - Health & signals (8m)
3) Jon - Onboarding & mitigation (7m)
4) Matt - Demo (10m) + fallback plan
5) Q&A (10m)

Action items:
- Sophia: finalize slides 6 and 9 (Wed EOD)
- Jon: insert customer metrics + retention bullets (Wed noon)
- Matt: record fallback demo + smoke test (Wed 3pm)
- Emily: confirm data points in CSV + grant view perms (Tue EOD)
- Ana: draft exec one-pager (Tue noon)
```

Sophia Patel: Slide 9 is updated but swapping the risk chart for a simple table — execs prefer clear numbers. Can we get engineering sign-off on the phrase "fallback knob" vs "fallback routing"? @Matt

Matt Chen: I'll review language. Also proposing an A/B fallback: route to a smaller quantized variant if primary model latency spikes. Need runtime team signoff — @Jonathan Ruiz?

Jonathan Ruiz: Ack — can confirm routing policy and quantized variant are available. I'll run tests with the traffic generator Mon-Wed and report results. If anything fails, we can use the recorded walkthrough as immediate fallback.

Ana Santiago: Exec one-pager should be 1 slide: 3 bullets (renewal risk, capacity ask, support window) + ask section. I'll draft and share by Tue noon.

Jon Reyes: For renewal risk scoring, are we using rubric v2 (the one we rolled out last quarter)? If so I'll annotate the slide with the score and the top 2 risk drivers.

Emily Tran: Yes, rubric v2. I'll add a notation column to the CSV and flag any missing metrics. Also confirming permissions so the execs can view the deck.

Sophia Patel: Who will run live Q&A? I can moderate, but prefer Ana to lead for exec presence.

Ana Santiago: I'll lead Q&A, Sophia moderates. @qbr-bot please pin the runbook doc to the channel.

qbr-bot: Runbook pinned.

Matt Chen: Quick technical ask — if the quantized model is used as fallback, we need to ensure prompt templates are compatible (token truncation differences). I'll add a checklist to the runbook.

Sophia Patel: Noted. Also adding a one-slide demo fallback flow for execs to avoid live confusion.

Ana Santiago: Thanks all. Please mark items done as you complete them and ping if blockers. Let's aim for one clean dry run Wed afternoon if components are ready. :thumbsup:
